bibl.title: Rural Collective Action in Byzantine Egypt (400-700 CE).
bibl.seg: Elizabeth Buchanan, Rural Collective Action in Byzantine Egypt (400-700 CE).

Alberto Nodar & Sofía Torallas Tovar (edd.), coedited by María Jesús Albarrán Martínez, Raquel Martín Hernández, Irene Pajón Leyra, José Domingo Rodríguez Martín & Marco Antonio Santamaría, Proceedings of the 28th Congress of Papyrology (Barcelona August 1st-6th, 2016) = Scripta Orientalia. 3 (Barcelona, 2019) pp. 591-599.
bibl.note: Studies the various terms found in the papyri that have been interpreted to refer to rural associations, the extent to which the law recognized rural associations, and their social as well as fiscal role.
